visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a black fleece jacket and white pants carries a young child in a blue cap on his shoulders outdoors against a backdrop of autumn trees. The woman then appears in a retail clothing store surrounded by bags, wearing a grey sweater and making a peace sign with her hand. (2) A fast-paced montage displays a young child eating at a wooden table in a restaurant, a brightly lit Christmas tree with gold tinsel, a man and woman clinking wine glasses in a dimly lit setting, and the couple sitting on a sofa sharing a can of Pringles chips. (3) The woman is seen in a domestic setting, wearing striped pajama pants while vacuuming under a table and later cleaning a bathroom sink and a kitchen hood. She then browses retail displays featuring traditional Japanese straw ornaments and large bamboo decorations known as Kadomatsu. (4) Detailed images of elaborate Osechi-ryori food boxes filled with seafood and vegetables are shown. The woman is filmed in close-up eating a bowl of soba noodles in a dark indoor environment, using wooden chopsticks to lift the noodles. (5) A promotional segment features a can of Pringles Consomme & Onion flavor. The woman eats the chips, reacting with delight. She displays various Pringles-themed merchandise including green and orange omamori charms and plush potato toys with faces. (6) The woman walks through a store filled with anime-related merchandise and uses a laptop at home. A man in a business suit waves goodbye in an entryway. Finally, the woman is seen eating a matcha green tea dessert in a restaurant stall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins with a driving beat. A female narrator speaks in a fast, bright, and cheerful Mandarin Chinese voice, introducing the busyness of December in Japan. (2) A crisp 'Whoosh' SFX accompanies the visual transition to the montage. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging as she lists various end-of-year activities. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat tempo. (3) Subtle mechanical whirring sounds of a vacuum and the rustling of fabric are mixed beneath the narration. A sharp 'Pop' SFX punctuates the transition to the food segment. (4) Distinct, crunchy 'Bite' SFX are heard clearly over the music as the woman eats potato chips, highlighting the texture. The voice quality is enunciated and clear, mimicking a broadcast style. (5) The audio concludes with a friendly farewell greeting from the narrator. The background music swells slightly before fading out into a clean finish, with no technical distortion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Context Hook -> Three-item List -> Product Promotion -> Seasonal Greeting
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to share Japanese cultural traditions regarding New Year preparations while strategically promoting Pringles' new flavors and retail collaborations in Taiwan. It uses a high-energy vlog format to build rapport before transitioning into a detailed product showcase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product packaging, taste testing, mention of retail availability (7-11/FamilyMart), and promotion of branded giveaway merchandise.
